{{Quote|Our biggest, most stacked slider! Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard, plankton spread, larded neutrinos and a fried blubberbird egg, with a green jumbolive on top, it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|The description of a Giju slider at Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Tapani triangles''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] which were used as an ingredient in [[Giju slider]]s. The sliders were served with Tapani triangles at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner of the diner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], created the slider&mdash;which he considered delicious&mdash;based on inspiration from the planet [[Giju/Legends|Giju]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and charged 7.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for it.<ref name="DaD" /> The [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] was the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] in which Giju was located.<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tapani triangles was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
